scenario: LUNI.8.6 / LUNI.7.5 — typed-let annotation must be either the `Float` builtin or a canonical unit symbol in scope. An alias like `degC` (of celsius) rejects with DS_VALIDATE_LET_BAD_ANNOTATION pointing at the canonical name. Same gate as schema slot types (LUNI.7.5).
rules_ds:
unit celsius: temperature = x + 273.15 alias degC

schema Reading scope logical:
    raw: Float key

rule bad:
    Reading r
->
    let t: degC = r.raw
    log info "never"
